criteria.requirement: Extend the already delivered BOM-aware RepositoryEnv with keyword-only strict=False. Strict mode rejects non-comment/nonblank lines without equals, empty trimmed keys and duplicate trimmed keys, with source path and physical one-based line number but no raw line or values in the diagnostic. Preserve UTF-8 BOM handling and embedded U+FEFF, empty values, splitting at the first equals, existing quotation handling, encoding errors and OS errors. Default tolerant skipping/last-value behavior remains unchanged; do not read unrelated files or execute shell syntax.
必须交付授权源码、能在原版失败的公开回归和中文兼容说明；所有冻结原生回归通过。

comparison: 依据真实程序行为接受等价实现，不按参考文本或篇幅评分。
